services.title: Pre-Wedding Video Editing
services.tagline: Cinematic romantic visual poetry with rhythmic cuts & drone pacing
services.shortDescription: Transform your pre-wedding raw footage into a dreamy, high-fashion cinematic love story with custom soundscapes.
services.detailedDescription: Full post-production treatment for pre-wedding shoots. Includes multi-camera audio sync, cinematic slow-motion speed ramps, specialized film-look color grading, personalized song mixing, dialogue mastering, and vertical teaser cuts for social media.
inclusions: Hollywood Grade Film Tone & Color Palette
exclusions: Raw footage shooting / camera equipment on location
Travel, food, lodging for shoot crew
Drone license permits or venue access charges

services.title: Wedding Video Highlights
services.tagline: Emotionally immersive master highlights capturing timeless rituals & celebrations
services.shortDescription: A breathless, tear-jerking cinematic wedding highlight film that captures every sacred ritual and joyful celebration.
services.detailedDescription: Comprehensive wedding film editing that weaves Muhurtham, Varapooja, Mangalashtak, and Reception into a seamless emotional narrative. Features advanced color science tailored for vibrant Indian traditional silks and golden lighting.
inclusions: 2x Vertical Teaser Reels for Social Sharing
Indian Silk & Gold Optimized Color Grading
Private High-Speed Isolated Master Delivery Locker
exclusions: On-venue videographers/photographers arrangements
Travel & accommodation for editing crew if spot-requested
Physical storage hard drives delivery couriers

services.title: Haldi & Sangeeth Ceremonies
services.tagline: High-energy beat-synced edits for joyful yellow splashes & vibrant dance nights
services.shortDescription: High-octane edits capturing playful yellow haldi splashes, family dances, musical sangeeth choreography, and unfiltered joy.
services.detailedDescription: Tailored specifically for high-energy Indian pre-wedding celebrations. We employ dynamic beat matching, speed ramps, yellow-hue color isolation, and multi-track audio mastering to turn dance performances and haldi celebrations into festive masterpieces.
inclusions: Individual Dance Performance Individual Track Cuts
Haldi Color Splash Pop & Yellow HDR Grading
exclusions: On-site video recording crew or sound stage setup
Travel, food, and local venue access charges

services.title: Maternity Shoot Videos
services.tagline: Tender, heartwarming visual keepsakes celebrating the miracle of new life
services.shortDescription: Soft, luminous, and deeply personal maternity films celebrating the anticipation and love of expectant parents.
services.detailedDescription: Soft-contrast film aesthetics, warm pastel tones, and gentle pacing to highlight motherhood grace and family anticipation. Perfect for intimate indoor and scenic outdoor maternity sessions.
inclusions: Soft Dreamy Film Look & Skin Tone Smoothing
exclusions: Studio rental or outdoor shoot permits
Travel & stay expenses for shoot

services.title: Baby Ceremony Videos (Naming/Birthday)
services.tagline: Playful, vibrant storytelling for cradle ceremonies & milestone birthdays
services.shortDescription: Vibrant, joyful edits capturing your little one’s naming ceremony, cradle rituals, or first birthday celebrations.
services.detailedDescription: Whimsical color grading, cheerful upbeat musical pacing, and warm family candid moments immortalized for generations to come.
exclusions: Event videography coverage on location
Food & travel expenses

services.title: House Warming Ceremonies (Gruhapravesam)
services.tagline: Sacred pooja traditions & architectural home walk-throughs in pristine 4K
services.shortDescription: Documenting the sacred Gruhapravesam rituals, homam blessings, family welcomes, and architectural beauty of your new dream home.
services.detailedDescription: Combines reverent coverage of sacred Vedic poojas and homam ceremonies with smooth, architectural cinematic walkthroughs highlighting the interiors and warmth of the new home.
inclusions: Pooja & Homam Sacred Mantras Audio Clean-up
exclusions: Camera recording crew and drone pilot on location
Travel & food arrangements

services.title: Cinematic Teasers & Vertical Reels
services.tagline: High-impact 9:16 viral edits crafted to stop the scroll and captivate viewers
services.shortDescription: Punchy, trend-aligned vertical reels and teaser promos optimized for Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and WhatsApp Status.
services.detailedDescription: Engineered for viral retention with instant visual hooks, precision sync to trending audio, seamless sound design effects (whooshes, risers), and punchy color grading.
exclusions: Video shoot production on location

services.title: Event Coverage & Montages
services.tagline: Dynamic recap edits for corporate summits, anniversaries & cultural galas
services.shortDescription: Sleek, sophisticated event highlight montages for corporate gatherings, grand openings, anniversaries, and cultural galas.
services.detailedDescription: Multi-cam speaker highlights, audience reaction cutaways, sponsor billboard integration, keynote sound mastering, and executive presentation recaps.
inclusions: Sponsor Logo & Title Lower Thirds Graphics
exclusions: On-site video production and staging equipment

services.title: Spot Editing Available (Same-Day On-Venue)
services.tagline: Instant same-day wedding edit ready for reception LED screens & live social blast
services.shortDescription: Live on-venue high-speed video editing! Watch morning wedding rituals projected as a grand cinematic film at the evening reception.
services.detailedDescription: Kurudi Bharath Kumar brings his mobile high-performance editing rig directly to your wedding venue. Raw morning ceremony footage is ingested, graded, mastered, and delivered in real-time within hours for a jaw-dropping evening reception screening.
inclusions: Same-Day On-Venue Live Editing (Same Day Delivery)
Ready for Reception Large LED Wall Projection (4K/1080p)
Instant Teaser for Live Social Media Sharing
Dedicated Mobile High-End Workstation Setup at Venue
exclusions: Travel, food & accommodation for editor (managed by client)
LED wall projector rental (provided by event venue/client)
Camera recording team (supplied by client or contracted separately)

services.title: AI-Assisted Video Creation & 3D Animation
services.tagline: Next-generation AI neural frame enhancements, 3D titles & smart rotoscoping
services.shortDescription: Studio Next-Gen Lab: Harnessing neural AI frame interpolation, smart object removal, automated multicam sync, and 3D titles.
services.detailedDescription: Future-ready post-production combining cutting-edge AI neural upscaling to 8K, AI voice audio isolation, smart generative fill for clean backgrounds, and bespoke 3D cinematic opening titles.
inclusions: AI Voice Denoise & Dialogue Clarity Enhancement
exclusions: Full manual 3D character rigging projects

publicWorks.title: RECEPTION VIDEO
publicWorks.description: A cinematic reception video capturing the joy, elegance, and memorable moments of the celebration. Smooth transitions, warm tones, balanced audio, and well-paced visuals create a polished and emotional presentation.

publicWorks.title: MUHURTHAM VIDEO
publicWorks.description: A cinematic Muhūrtham video capturing the traditional and emotional essence of the special occasion. Smooth transitions, warm cinematic tones, balanced audio, and carefully paced visuals create an elegant and memorable presentation.

testimonials.reviewText: Bharath Kumar gave us chills with our wedding highlight film! The way he synced our Mangalashtak mantras with the emotional teary-eyed moments of our parents was pure magic. Delivered right on time and in stunning 4K quality!

studioCMS.tagline: Cinematic Storytelling Crafted With Precision | Premium Post-Production & Color Science
studioCMS.founderTitle: Founder, Lead Video Editor & Master Colorist
studioCMS.founderBio: Kurudi Bharath Kumar is an accomplished filmmaker, post-production specialist, and senior colorist based in Hindupur, Andhra Pradesh. With an academic background in Computer Applications, Advertising, and Business Management, he combines technical rigor with emotive visual pacing to transform raw event footage into timeless, cinematic masterworks.

coreHighlights: Distinction in Professional Video & Media Internships

editingSuites: DaVinci Resolve Studio (Advanced Color Grading & Fairlight Audio)
Adobe After Effects (Cinematic VFX & Motion Graphics)
FilmConvert Nitrate & Dehancer Pro (Film Emulation LUTs)
Custom Calibrated OLED & DaVinci Speed Editor Rig
studioCMS.priceDisclaimer: The displayed price covers only the selected editing or video-production service and the deliverables stated in your booking. Accommodation, food, travel, local transport, venue charges, permits, courier expenses, and any other on-location or third-party expenses are not included unless specifically confirmed in writing. These arrangements and costs must be managed by the client.
termsAndConditions: The displayed service fee applies only to the selected service and agreed deliverables.
Accommodation, food, travel, local transport, venue charges, permits, courier charges, and third-party expenses are excluded unless separately confirmed in writing.
The client is responsible for arranging and paying all excluded expenses.
Final scope, delivery date, and any custom quotation are confirmed after the owner reviews the service request.
Delivery timelines depend on project complexity, timely submission of required footage/materials, and client feedback.
Revisions are handled according to the agreed service scope. Additional revisions or changes outside the agreed scope may require an additional charge.
The client confirms they have permission to provide all photos, videos, music references, logos, and other materials submitted for the project.
Private delivered files are available through the client portal for the selected access period. Clients should download and safely back up their files.
KBK Film Studios may display completed work publicly only after receiving client approval.
By submitting this request, the client agrees to these terms.
